content: "Mitochondria" is Kenichi Suzumura's third single, released on February 4, 2009. It came with a disc with the PV of the title track "Mitochondria", and peaked at #20 on the Oricon charts.[1][2]
All lyrics are written by Kenichi Suzumura.
